purpose: CountUp 数字滚动; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandCountUp](../../lib/src/components/count_up.dart), [IslandCountUpRepeat](../../lib/src/components/count_up.dart), [IslandCountUpController](../../lib/src/components/count_up.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: One owner manages numeric timeline and callbacks; opaque builder retains identity through celebration.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints. NumberSurface owns only the shared outer decoration; NumberPlate owns the inner numeric plate. The component owns its time model, callbacks, semantics and opaque slots; explicit child styles win.
interface.accessibility: semanticLabel supplies an explicit accessible name, default null. The component exposes the formatted value only when its timeline is idle; builder/prefix/suffix are visual slots excluded from focus and descendant semantics. Controls belong outside these slots. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Celebration content remains opaque for900ms in normal/reduced mode; reduced skips only decoration/pop. Reset/disposal cancel pending removal.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. Celebration foreground is light.onSun across the full amber gradient, at every pulse frame. Owned readable text roles also set default icon roles. Fixed light content surfaces scope light semantic roles for nested public controls; explicit child styles and unrelated ThemeExtensions remain unchanged. Dashed strokes use the single public foundation painter under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke. This component retains its existing shape, color, width, dash/gap, state and content ownership; no second contour loop or consumer-private import.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.given: Necessary content on its actual supporting surface, including reduced-motion changes
scenarios.when: Enter, sample intermediate frames, reverse/reopen, close, cancel and unmount
scenarios.then: Content/backing stay readable; one subtree retains state; hit/focus/semantics track availability; no stale timer or duplicate callback. Approved reference deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md.

scenarios.given: The relevant owned state and actual supported background, including transition frames
scenarios.when: Focus, hover, entry, exit or reduced motion changes
scenarios.then: Celebration foreground is light.onSun across the full amber gradient, at every pulse frame.

scenarios.given: The existing dashed recipe in each supported size, applicable state and target pixel ratio, with opaque content
scenarios.when: Render and update the same component, including its current hover/press/focus and stroke-width recipes where applicable
scenarios.then: The contour, final short dash and inset match the unchanged recipe; all drawing uses the shared public foundation mechanism. Content geometry, callback/focus behavior and lifecycle remain unchanged under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke.
